newsitem.title: USA: Banco Santander-Chile revises merger charges.
newsitem.headline: Banco Santander-Chile revises merger charges.

text.p: Banco Santander-Chile said on Tuesday that it expects greater-than-anticipated savings in 1997 and greater restructuring costs in 1996 from its merger with Banco Osorno.

The bank said the merger is advancing faster than expected. Because of this, it said, savings could be as high as $40 million in 1997, compared to originally estimated savings of about $30 million starting in 1998.
A quicker merger also means restructuring costs of about $28 million in 1996 as opposed to the $20 million initially announced, the bank said.
